title: Vector databases in 2025
article_body: Vector databases store high-dimensional embeddings and let applications retrieve semantically similar items by approximate nearest neighbor search. They are central to RAG pipelines.

title: Operational AI patterns
article_body: Operational AI brings model inference next to live data so that recommendations, fraud scoring, and personalization can run with sub-second latency on the freshest events.

title: Embeddings explained
article_body: An embedding maps a piece of text or media into a fixed-length numeric vector that captures meaning. Cosine similarity over embeddings approximates semantic similarity.

title: Hybrid transactional analytics
article_body: Hybrid transactional and analytical processing systems run mixed OLTP and OLAP workloads on the same data, removing the lag between writes and analytics.

title: Why bring models to data
article_body: Moving small results back from a database is cheap. Moving large datasets out to a model is expensive. Co-locating compute and storage flips the cost curve in the right direction.

title: Choosing an embedding dimension
article_body: Higher-dimensional embeddings retain more nuance but cost more at retrieval time. 384 to 1024 dimensions is a common sweet spot for production semantic search.

title: Sentiment analysis at scale
article_body: Sentiment analysis turns free-text feedback into actionable signal. At scale you need both throughput and a clear mapping from raw text to business decisions.

title: Real-time fraud signals
article_body: Fraud detection benefits from combining velocity rules, behavioral baselines and language-aware reasoning over transaction descriptions.

title: Customer churn prediction
article_body: Churn prediction blends behavioral telemetry — login frequency, feature use, recency — with signals derived from support sentiment and NPS surveys.

title: Semantic search vs keyword search
article_body: Keyword search is fast and precise for known queries. Semantic search shines when users phrase their intent in unfamiliar language. Hybrid systems use both.
